clue.text: Stick that's split?

definitions.meaning: to stick is to adhere or cling closely to something
to split is to divide or chop apart, as with an axe

explanation.walkthrough: The word is its own opposite: it means both to cling and to cut apart.
explanation.definitionFit: One verb has two contrary senses: cling fast (synonym of stick) and hew apart (synonym of split).

clue.text: Brave pirate's superficial improvement

parts.note: to brave a danger is to face it
to pirate is to steal or copy, i.e. to lift

explanation.surface: A daring buccaneer gets a cosmetic makeover.
explanation.definitionFit: Cosmetic surgery to tighten the skin is literally a surface-level enhancement, and figuratively any cosmetic revamp.

clue.text: Walk slowly along the street with a list

parts.note: ST is the standard abbreviation for street
a roll is a list of names, as in a register

explanation.surface: Someone ambles down the road clutching a shopping list.
explanation.definitionFit: A leisurely, unhurried walk is a synonym for this word, used as a verb here.

clue.text: Port or sherry?

definitions.meaning: a seaport city in south-west England
... Cream is a famous brand of sweet sherry

explanation.walkthrough: 'Port' tempts you towards the fortified wine; it is a harbour city. BRISTOL is an English port city, and Bristol Cream a well-known sherry.
explanation.definitionFit: The English harbour city lends its name to a well-known cream sherry, so both senses fit.

clue.text: Father about to see doctor in confidence

indicators.note: about signals that the word for father turns round

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
lo is an old word meaning look or see
MB is a medical degree, Bachelor of Medicine

explanation.surface: A dad is going to visit his GP in confidence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in confidence' reads as privately, but 'confidence' is the definition, meaning self-assurance. 'about' turns PA into AP.
explanation.definitionFit: Poise and self-assurance under pressure is a synonym for confidence in the sense of composure.

clue.text: Beautiful lady in hat smeared unfairly

indicators.note: in places the beautiful lady inside the hat

parts.note: lid is slang for a hat
a belle is a beautiful woman

explanation.surface: A lovely woman in a hat has her make-up smudged.
explanation.definitionFit: Defamed in writing, a past-tense verb meaning slandered or smeared without justification.

clue.text: You may get unusually late roses from these shrubs

indicators.note: unusually signals the letters of the words late roses are arranged in an unusual way

explanation.surface: A gardening tip: these bushes may give you an odd crop of late-flowering roses.
explanation.definitionFit: Oleasters are Eurasian shrubs or small trees of the genus Elaeagnus, the wild olive.

clue.text: Rent a place in Croatia

definitions.meaning: a rent is a tear or crack, as in cloth
a port city on the Dalmatian coast of Croatia

explanation.walkthrough: 'Rent' looks like a payment for housing; here it is a noun meaning a tear.
explanation.definitionFit: A tear in fabric is a split, and Split is also a Croatian coastal city.

clue.text: Fast mover's chores are arranged in orderly fashion

indicators.note: arranged in orderly fashion signals the letters of chores are rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A quick worker tidies up the household jobs neatly.
explanation.definitionFit: A thoroughbred bred for the turf is an animal that moves at high speed on the track.

clue.text: One who stands up for another's rights

definitions.text: One who stands up for another's rights

parts.words: One who stands up for another's rights
parts.note: reads like a civil-liberties campaigner, but describes a fighter staying upright under an opponent's right-hand punches

explanation.surface: A campaigner defends the civil rights of others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rights' are punches thrown with the right hand, and 'stands up' means staying on your feet.
explanation.definitionFit: A prizefighter must stay upright while taking an opponent's right-hand blows in the ring.

clue.text: Drop in rent

definitions.meaning: a drop of liquid from the eye
past tense of rend, meaning torn; also a rip

explanation.walkthrough: 'Drop in rent' sounds like a lower charge for housing; it is two senses of one word, a teardrop and a rip.
explanation.definitionFit: Spelt the same, it names a droplet from the eye and also a rip in cloth.

clue.text: Daniel's upset at rejection

indicators.note: upset signals the letters of Daniel are knocked into a new order

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: Daniel is upset at being turned down.
explanation.definitionFit: Refusing to accept or admit something is a rejection of it.

clue.text: Too adventurous with series of deliveries completed, say

indicators.note: say signals that the phrase is to be spoken, giving a word that sounds alike

parts.note: in cricket an over is a series of six deliveries; once completed it has been bowled

explanation.surface: A cricket over finished with daring play is too adventurous.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an over is a set of six balls bowled by one bowler.
explanation.definitionFit: Excessively daring or presumptuous, i.e. bolder than is wise.

clue.text: It takes those attending outside to excite trouble

indicators.note: takes signals one piece holding another within it
outside says those attending go round the outside of it

parts.note: a gate is the number of spectators attending a sporting event
taken as written

explanation.surface: Bringing in outsiders is what it takes to stir up trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: A GATE, the attendance at a match, goes outside IT.
explanation.definitionFit: To stir up or campaign for unrest is to provoke disturbance, a synonym of stirring things up.

clue.text: The issue of offspring

parts.note: issue means children, so the child of one's child is meant

explanation.surface: A question about having children.
explanation.walkthrough: 'issue' reads as a topic but means a descendant, as in legal language.
explanation.definitionFit: A son's or daughter's male child is the issue, or descendant, of one's own children.

clue.text: What the ballet dancer wore for the archbishop

definitions.meaning: a short stiff skirt of layered net worn by ballerinas

explanation.walkthrough: Desmond Tutu was the South African archbishop and anti-apartheid campaigner.
explanation.definitionFit: A ballerina's frilled skirt shares its name with Desmond Tutu, the South African cleric.

clue.text: Quietly withdraw and go before the others

parts.note: p is the musical abbreviation for piano, quietly
to recede is to move back or withdraw

explanation.surface: Someone discreetly slips away ahead of the rest of the group.
explanation.definitionFit: To come or go ahead of others in time or order is a synonym of leading.

clue.text: Scotsman comes up with a chap totally Welsh

indicators.note: comes up signals the Scotsman's word reads upward, i.e. backwards in a down clue

parts.note: Mac is a familiar name for a Scotsman
Brian is just a man's name, any chap

explanation.surface: A Scot arrives with a fellow who is entirely Welsh.
explanation.walkthrough: 'comes up' turns MAC into CAM in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Cambria is the Latin name for Wales, so the adjective means wholly of Wales.

clue.text: Reserve of strength in a football team

definitions.meaning: a store of weapons or resources

explanation.walkthrough: Arsenal is a famous north London football club.
explanation.definitionFit: A stockpile of weapons or resources, and also the name of a London Premier League club.

clue.text: Guard the unruly girl

indicators.note: unruly signals the letters of guard the are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Keep watch over the badly behaved young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A female child is someone's girl, as in 'their girl is at college'.

clue.text: Acquire husband

definitions.meaning: to gather or obtain, as in gathering support
as a verb, to husband is to store up or conserve

explanation.walkthrough: 'husband' looks like a noun but is the verb meaning to save or store carefully.
explanation.definitionFit: To collect and store, as grain in a granary, fits both obtaining and conserving.

clue.text: Don't go and clip them in wet weather

indicators.note: in puts the clipped word inside the wet weather

parts.note: rain is wet weather

indicators.note: clip signals the front of the word them is cut off, as in the colloquial form

explanation.surface: Stay indoors and trim them while it pours outside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clip' cuts TH from 'them', leaving EM, the colloquial 'em.
explanation.definitionFit: To stay put rather than leave is the imperative sense here.

clue.text: Recover one's possession

parts.note: reads as getting back composure, or getting back what one owned

explanation.surface: Someone gets their property back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possession' can mean self-possession, composure, which one gets back.
explanation.definitionFit: To get something back again, whether an item or one's composure, is to retrieve it.

clue.text: Lined up during altercation

parts.note: in means during, as in 'in the night'
a row is a quarrel or altercation

explanation.surface: Queued in line while an argument breaks out.
explanation.definitionFit: Arranged one after another in a line, the idiom for consecutive or aligned.

clue.text: A party with sailors on deck

parts.note: a do is an informal party
RN, the Royal Navy, stands for sailors

explanation.surface: A party with sailors held on the ship's deck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deck' sits by sailors as a ship's floor; it is the verb meaning decorate.
explanation.definitionFit: To deck out is to decorate or embellish, a synonym for beautify.

clue.text: A seven-stone pauper?

definitions.meaning: the seventh in the rhyme counting cherry stones

explanation.walkthrough: 'seven-stone' looks like a body weight; it is the seventh cherry stone in the children's fortune-telling rhyme.
explanation.definitionFit: A destitute person who begs for a living, and the seventh figure in the cherry-stone counting rhyme.

clue.text: Piped down?

parts.note: piped down reads as told to be quiet, but means sprayed down with water from a pipe

explanation.surface: Has someone been told to be quiet?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Piped down' sounds like being quiet; think of a pipe used for washing something down.
explanation.definitionFit: Washed down with a garden pipe or spray, as a car or yard might be.

clue.text: One who gives guidance to a raving lunatic

indicators.note: lunatic signals the letters of to a raving are scrambled madly

explanation.surface: Someone offers advice to a madman.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who plots a route and steers, as on a ship or in a rally car.
